subject: Org entry: admin handoff & initial access naming + key seeding
messages:
From: Ben Lu <benlu@orcahealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.parker@orcahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New customer onboarding — initial access & naming conventions

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. We're Orca Health — small engineering org, security-first. We want to get the initial workspace set up this week if possible: projects, seed API keys for two service accounts (staging + prod), and the admin invites for our two SREs and one PM.

High level asks:
- Project / namespace naming standard you recommend
- Initial RBAC roles you suggest for admin / ops / billing
- How you seed API keys and whether those are pushed to our secret manager or provided as CSV
- KMS / HSM integration guidance for root keys (we use GCP KMS)

I'll attach our initial SRE list and org domain. Can we do a 30-min kickoff today or tomorrow?

Thanks,
Ben

Attachment: orca-internal-admins.csv (csv)

From: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Lu <benlu@orcahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — initial access & naming conventions

Hi Ben — great to meet you over email. Welcome aboard.

Quick plan for the initial handoff (30-min kickoff + follow-up tasks):
1) Kickoff call: 30 mins to confirm account owners, SSO domain, and scope (we can do today 3pm PT or tomorrow 10am PT).
2) Naming conventions (we'll apply these when we provision):
   - Project: orca-prod, orca-staging, orca-internal-tools (short, lowercase, hyphenated)
   - Service accounts: svc-orca-inference-prod, svc-orca-inference-staging
   - Keys: rdw-svc-<service>-v1 (we increment on rotation)
3) Initial RBAC (we'll seed these roles during provisioning):
   - workspace_admin (full admin, invited for 2 SREs)
   - billing_viewer (for finance visibility)
   - inference_operator (can start/stop jobs, view logs)
4) API key seeding options (pick one):
   A) We generate keys and upload a CSV to your secure Drive folder (short-lived keys; you import to secret manager)
   B) We provide console-only keys and you create service accounts and secrets (preferred for max tenant control)
5) KMS/HSM: we support GCP KMS. Karthik will share the exact IAM bindings we need and the recommended key ring layout.
6) Next deliverables (post-kickoff): credentials-template.csv, SAML metadata file for your IdP, and an admin roles matrix PDF.

I've attached the credentials-template.csv and SAML metadata for your IdP to accelerate the setup. Monica will schedule the kickoff and own the invites. Karthik will handle KMS and service-account provisioning.

If that sounds good, confirm preferred kickoff slot and preferred key-seeding option (A or B).

Best,
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial-credentials-template.csv, saml-metadata.xml, admin-roles-matrix.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Lu <benlu@orcahealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — initial access & naming conventions

Thanks Ben — I'm booking the 30-min slot for tomorrow 10:00am PT and sending a calendar invite now.

A couple of practical notes for the kickoff so we can move fast:
- Please have one owner (SRE) on the call with access to your GCP project and your IdP admin console.
- If you pick option A (we generate keys), confirm where we should upload the CSV (Drive folder link or Slack channel). We recommend uploading to a locked Drive folder and then you transfer to your secret manager; we will not store long-term.
- Recommended ephemeral rotation cadence for seeded keys: 30 days for staging, 90 days for prod (you can shorten if you prefer). We'll record rotation reminders in the kickoff doc.
- Service-account IAM bindings Karthik needs: roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin on the target project and roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for the KMS key.

I'll include an agenda in the invite: intros, SSO check, project naming confirmation, seeding approach, next steps + owners.

See you tomorrow — invite sent.

— Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Lu <benlu@orcahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New customer onboarding — initial access & naming conventions

Thanks everyone — quick technical checklist and links (post-kickoff):

1) GCP KMS setup we need from Orca:
   - Key ring: projects/<project-id>/locations/us-central1/keyRings/orca-rdw-ring
   - Key name: rdw-root-key (set purpose: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT)
   - IAM: grant service account 'svc-orca-provisioner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com' roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
2) SCIM / SAML: we'll consume SAML metadata attached; if you want SCIM provisioning, provide an API token for the IdP (we only request read+provision scopes).
3) Service-account naming and sample gcloud commands (we will run these if you choose option B):
   - gcloud iam service-accounts create svc-orca-inference-prod --display-name="Orca inference prod"
   - gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding <project-id> --member=serviceAccount:svc-orca-inference-prod@<project-id>.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
4) Key rotation automation: we can wire a Cloud Scheduler job that calls your rotation endpoint or we can run rotations from our infra and issue a short-lived token via the Google secret manager; let us know preference.

Links: Drive folder with templates and kickoff notes:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-orca-onboard
Orderform (to sign if you'd like Dedicated capacity reserved):
https://www.docusign.com/links/rdw-orderform-orca

I'll drop a follow-up doc with exact IAM JSON snippets and a sample Terraform snippet for service-account creation.

— Karthik
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
